title: Agent-path probe: day plans, plan edits, named stops and member live questions (v1 vs v2 before API-BB-CUTOVER)
notes: Not part of the scored casebook (the loader only reads cases-A..H). Run with --probe agent-path. Every turn routes to the v2 agent loop (day_plan, plan_edit, named_stops or live_web), the path the 70-turn casebook never reaches. Model rounds are not capped. Web search is the local stub and source reads fail closed (no network), the same for both engines, so a member's live question tests how each engine handles an unavailable check. Gold is code-checked: assistant route, script, no assurance or booking claims, and grounded $ amounts on admission turns; plan stop counts and plan-guard warnings are read from the result rows.
